如果此书侵犯了您的权益，请点击访问作者版权投诉快速通道    五年前，九州大陆惊现异象。
九色神雷盘旋于整座大陆之天际，威势滔天，足以将大陆毁灭。
可当神雷劈落而下后，却忽然消失，莫说毁灭大陆，连一丝破坏都未造成，诡异至极。
而那神雷劈落之地，正是九州中最贫瘠的青州境内。
此事，惊动整座大陆，大陆统治者姜氏皇朝，更是派诸多高手前往青州寻找真相……
只是足足五年过去，却始终未能找到任何线索。
青州境内，宗门林立，青龙宗便是其中之一。
今日，乃是青龙宗每年一度，招收弟子的日子。
青龙宗外，人山人海。
可一位想让孩子拜入青龙宗的妇人，却对一名青龙宗弟子破口大骂。
“你这种低等的杂役，也配赶我走？”
这妇人，指着身前的少年，不仅凶神恶煞，眼中更是充满藐视。
她之所以敢如此猖狂，只因那少年，乃是青龙宗外门弟子。
外门弟子，虽也是青龙宗之人，但却地位极低，在宗门内宛如杂役。
就连外人，也是看不起他们。
“夫人，宗门已经关闭，若想拜入宗门，还是明日再来吧。”
“另外，我提醒你一句，这里是青龙宗，可不是你能撒泼的地方，我劝你谨言慎行。”
少年凝声说道。
他叫做楚枫，年近十五岁。
虽是外门弟子，可胆量却比常人要大的多，从他顶撞妇人这一点，就少有人敢。

“小兔崽子，区区外门弟子，胆敢威胁我？”
“我告诉你，你立刻给我们母子安排住处，不然我和你没完。”
妇人更怒，竟一把抓住了楚枫的衣襟，那个架势就好像，楚枫若不从，她就要打楚枫一般。
可对于眼前这一幕，不仅没人上前劝解，反而都在旁边幸灾乐祸。
外门弟子，就是如此卑微，众人眼中，猪狗不如。
“楚枫弟，遇到麻烦了么？”
忽然，一道甜美的声音自宗门方向传来。
定目望去，所有人目光一变，男人们，更是双眼发直。
那是一名少女，此女无论是容貌，还是气质都是极其出众。
尤其她那裙摆下的一双美腿，白皙如雪，阳光照射之下，竟闪闪发光，看得在场男子，直咽口水。
少女虽美，可眼眸却极为凌厉，那凌厉的目光，此时正落在妇人身上，清冷的声音响起：“你在干什么？”
“没事没事，我只是跟这位小兄弟，询问一些事罢了。”说着还拍了拍了少年因为拉扯而发皱的衣服。
妇人笑的极为僵硬，就连脸色都变得惨白。
不因别的，只因少女身上的紫色长裙，乃是青龙宗内门弟子的标志。
内门弟子，与外门弟子，如天地之别，她这种平民，根本不敢得罪。
少女看着妇人，只说了一个字：“滚。”
听闻此话，妇人没有一丝犹豫，牵着男孩便快步离去，慌乱之间竟还摔了一个跟头，狼狈至极。
见状，楚枫走到少女身前，施以一礼：“多谢楚月师姐”
“什么师姐？跟我你还客气，咱们可是一家人。”楚月眉头一皱，有些不悦。
她说的没错，楚枫与她的确是一家人，他们来自同一个世家，楚家。

这楚月正是楚枫二伯家的堂姐，只比楚枫大一岁。
不过，楚月在三年前就已通过内门考核，成为内门弟子，如今已是灵武四重的高手。
“宗门规矩，总是要遵守的。”楚枫灿烂的笑道。
“哎”然而看着这样的楚枫，楚月却是心头一酸：“楚枫弟，今年的内门考核你还不参加么？难道，你还没有达到灵武三重？”
楚枫并未回答，脸上依然挂着微笑，没人知道他这是什么意思。
见状，楚月从腰间取下一只锦囊，放到了楚枫的手中：“将它炼化，也许能够帮你突破三重。”
楚枫将锦囊正倒卧其中。
“楚月姐，这太贵重了，我不能要。”楚枫赶忙还给了楚月。
仙灵草，乃是修武圣药，极为珍贵，对灵武境以内的修武者，皆有无尽的功效。
而楚家为了让他们快速提升修为，每年都会补贴他们每人一株仙灵草。
想来楚月这株，也是家族补贴的，只是楚月并未享有，反而是给了他，这让楚枫感动之余，更是不忍接受。
“我说给你，你就拿着，还是不是我弟弟。”楚月有些不悦。
“哟，楚月姐什么时候这么大方了，仙灵草竟然也要送人？”

content_en:
If this book infringes upon your rights, please click to visit the author’s fast track for copyright complaints. Five years ago, a strange phenomenon occurred in Kyushu Continent.
The nine-color divine thunder hovered in the sky across the entire continent, with overwhelming power that could destroy the continent.
But when the divine thunder struck down, it suddenly disappeared. Not to mention destroying the continent, it didn't even cause any damage. It was extremely strange.
And the place where the divine thunder struck was the territory of Qingzhou, the most barren among the nine states.
This incident shocked the entire continent. The ruler of the continent, the Jiang Dynasty, even sent many experts to Qingzhou to find the truth...
It's just that five full years have passed, but no clues have been found.
There are many sects in Qingzhou, and Qinglong Sect is one of them.
Today is the annual day for Qinglong Sect to recruit disciples.
Outside Qinglong Sect, there was a sea of ​​people.
But a woman who wanted her child to join the Qinglong Sect cursed a Qinglong Sect disciple.
"A lowly handyman like you is worthy of driving me away?"
The woman pointed at the young man in front of her. Not only did she look fierce, but her eyes were full of contempt.
The reason why she dared to be so arrogant was because that young man was an outer disciple of Qinglong Sect.
Although the outer disciples are also members of the Qinglong Sect, their status is extremely low and they are like handymen within the sect.
Even outsiders look down on them.
"Madam, the sect has been closed. If you want to join the sect, you'd better come back tomorrow."
"Also, let me remind you that this is the Qinglong Sect, and this is not a place where you can act recklessly. I advise you to be careful in your words and actions."
The young man said in a solemn voice.
His name is Chu Feng, and he is nearly fifteen years old.
Although he is an outer disciple, his courage is much greater than ordinary people. From the fact that he contradicts a woman, few people dare to.
"You little bastard, you're just an outside disciple, how dare you threaten me?"
"I'm telling you, you should arrange a place for us mother and son immediately, otherwise I will never be done with you."
The woman became even more angry and actually grabbed Chu Feng by the lapel of his clothes. Her posture was as if she was going to beat Chu Feng if he didn't obey.
But regarding the scene in front of them, not only did no one come forward to persuade him, but everyone was gloating about it.
Outer disciples are so humble, and in the eyes of everyone, they are inferior to pigs and dogs.
"Brother Chu Feng, are you in trouble?"
Suddenly, a sweet voice came from the direction of the sect.
Looking intently, everyone's eyes changed, and the men's eyes widened even more.
That was a young girl. This girl was extremely outstanding both in appearance and temperament.
Especially her beautiful legs under her skirt, which were as white as snow and sparkled under the sunlight, making the men present gulp down their saliva.
Although the girl was beautiful, her eyes were extremely sharp. That sharp gaze was falling on the woman at this moment, and a cold voice sounded: "What are you doing?"
"It's okay, it's okay. I'm just asking this little brother about something." He said and patted the boy's clothes that were wrinkled due to pulling.
The woman smiled so stiffly that her face turned pale.
For no other reason than the purple dress on the girl's body, it was the symbol of an inner disciple of the Qinglong Sect.
The inner disciples were as different as the outer disciples, and a commoner like her would not dare to offend them.
The girl looked at the woman and said only one word: "Get out."
After hearing this, the woman didn't hesitate at all. She took the boy and left quickly. In her panic, she even fell down and was extremely embarrassed.
Seeing this, Chu Feng walked up to the girl and saluted: "Thank you, Senior Sister Chu Yue."
"What senior sister? Are you being polite to me? We are a family." Chu Yue frowned, a little displeased.
What she said was right. Chu Feng and she were indeed one family. They came from the same aristocratic family, the Chu family.
This Chu Yue is the cousin of Chu Feng's second uncle's family, and is only one year older than Chu Feng.
However, Chu Yue passed the inner sect examination three years ago and became an inner sect disciple, and is now a master of the fourth level of Lingwu.
"Sect rules must always be followedof. "Chu Feng said with a bright smile.
"Hey" However, looking at Chu Feng like this, Chu Yue felt sad in her heart: "Brother Chu Feng, aren't you going to participate in this year's inner sect assessment? Could it be that you haven't reached the third level of Lingwu yet? "
Chu Feng did not answer, with a smile still on his face. No one knew what he meant.
Seeing this, Chu Yue took out a brocade bag from her waist and put it in Chu Feng's hand: "Refining it may help you break through to the third level. "
Chu Feng laid the brocade bag upside down in it.
"Sister Chu Yue, this is too valuable, I can't have it. "Chu Feng quickly returned it to Chu Yue.
Immortal Spirit Grass is a holy medicine for martial arts cultivation, extremely precious, and has endless effects on martial arts practitioners within the Spiritual Martial Realm.
In order to allow them to quickly improve their cultivation, the Chu family would subsidize each of them with a fairy grass every year.
It seems that Chu Yue's plant was also subsidized by the family, but Chu Yue did not enjoy it. Instead, it was given to him. This made Chu Feng so moved that he couldn't bear to accept it.
"I told you to give it to you, just take it, it's still not my brother. "Chu Yue was a little unhappy.
"Hey, when did Sister Chu Yue become so generous and want to give away fairy grass? "
